description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'DeviceIdentityStore' responsible for managing device identity data, including loading, creating, signing payloads, and verification. It also contains a data class 'DeviceIdentity' to represent the device's identity information. The class interacts with the filesystem, performs cryptographic operations using BouncyCastle, and handles JSON serialization.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: Data class representing device identity information, including device ID, public key, private key, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads an existing device identity or creates a new one if none exists, updating the cache accordingly.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the device's private key, returning a Base64 URL-safe encoded signature.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature of a payload using the device's public key.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Encodes the device's public key in Base64 URL-safe format.
